observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale: a low, domed animal covered in large cracked grey stone-like plates, with dark wrinkled limbs folded under the dome's edge. South is noticeably taller and more upright as a dome than east; east is longer and lower with a wedge-shaped head at the right; north is a rounded dome a little narrower than south.
observed.south.png: Front view. A broad dome of overlapping cracked ash-grey plates comes down into a wide, flat, plated head shaped like a spade. Two small dark eyes are set low on it, and a straight row of short blunt pale teeth runs the full width of the jaw. Thick, dark, wrinkled forelegs are folded inward at both lower corners. The edges are cleanly cut out with no ground under it. Painterly and muted, not glossy.
observed.east.png: Side profile facing right. A long, low, asymmetric dome of cracked grey plates tapers forward into a pointed, flat wedge of a head with a small eye and a row of blunt teeth along the lower jaw edge. Dark wrinkled legs are folded flat beneath the body, with toes visible at the front and back. The back is highest about a third of the way from the rear. It is lower overall than south.
observed.north.png: Rear view. A rounded dome of overlapping cracked plates, with the dark wrinkled hindquarters and folded hind legs tucked under the lower edge and a central fold of dark skin where a tail would be. No face and no eyes. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom it is about 1.8 cells long and about 0.8 cells tall beside a vanilla human: a low creature shaped like a boulder, longer than a human is tall but much lower. subject: RM_Fuzzrunner

reply.subject: RM_Fuzzrunner

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. Each shows a nearly spherical ball of fluffy, sandy-buff fur with grey-brown flecks along the back and paler cream fur on the belly and flanks. South: a small face sits low on the front of the ball, with two small dark eyes, a dark triangular nose, and a fan of long fine pale whiskers. Two small clawed forefeet peek out at the bottom. East: the same ball in profile. A short pointed snout with a black eye and pink-tipped nose faces right, long whiskers sweep back, and small clawed feet show under the belly. North: the same ball from behind, with a darker dorsal stripe running down the back, a vertical seam between the haunches, and two small hind feet at the base. No face. No tail visible on any facing. All three are about the same size.
observed.south.png: A front view of the round fur ball at full resolution. The face is centred in the lower half: two small dark eyes, a small dark nose, and dense long whiskers fanning out to both sides. The fur is finely painted with soft shading and a thin darker edge. Two small forepaws with claws sit at the bottom. The background is clean alpha.
observed.east.png: A side profile. The body is an oval ball, slightly longer than tall. The head blends into the body with no neck, ending in a short tapered snout with one black eye, a pinkish nose tip, and long pale whiskers, some of which droop below the chin. The back is darker and flecked, the flank and belly cream. Small hind claws show under the rear and a forefoot under the chin. No tail. The background is clean alpha.
observed.north.png: A rear view: the ball from behind, with fur parting along a darker spine line and a cleft between two rounded haunches. Two small hind feet show at the bottom. There are no eyes and no face, and no tail. The background is clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature is a pale round fur ball about 0.6 of a cell wide, sitting beside the vanilla human, whose head is roughly as big as it is. At normal play (32 px/cell) it is a small pale round blob beside the human and a rat, slightly larger than the rat's body, and reads as a fuzzy pale ball against the brown ground.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the face head-on: two eyes, nose and whiskers centred, forepaws at the bottom.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the back with a spine line, a haunch cleft and hind feet. No eyes, no face.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three are views at the game's angle with the feet on the bottom edge. None is a top-down disc.

SAME_SIZE.seen: Heights match visually, and code measured a 5% spread.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: The same fur colour, dorsal flecking, round body and whiskers appear on every facing. There are no extra structures that would need to turn with the body.

SIGNATURE.seen: The description's legible traits, round with fog-fat and navigating by whisker, are both clearly shown: a near-spherical body and prominent long whiskers.

ALIEN.seen: At first glance it reads as a fat hamster or lemming ball, an Earth rodent with nothing unfamiliar about its eyes, nose, whiskers, fur or claws. The card lists no departures, and none are drawn.

STYLE.seen: The fur is finely painted with soft realistic shading and a thin dark edge. The small eyes are not glossy or oversized and there is no smile, so it is not cel-shaded or cartoonish. The rotund shape alone leans slightly toward cute.

OURS.seen: A bespoke round furry creature that matches no vanilla or known mod animal.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out on every facing, with no ground patch, shadow or halo. Code measured real alpha present.

SCALE.seen: A small animal a bit bigger than the rat and well under human size. That fits a common small burrow-run creature, and the description gives no contradicting size words.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it reads as a distinct pale round ball against the brown ground, which is a simple bold shape.

request.subject: RM_Fuzzrunner

edits.change: The head is a smooth, blunt wedge with no rodent snout and no visible nose-and-mouth muzzle; the eyes are small vestigial slits sealed under pale lids, set in a flat brow plate, suited to a creature that has never seen open light. Feelers carry the sense of the face instead.

Dozens of long, thin, stiff sensory filaments sprout in rows along the brow, the cheeks and both flanks, fanning outward and swept slightly back, like a ring of antennae on a round body. They are longer and more numerous than any whisker set, and read as a navigating organ.
The coat is dense stone-like mottled fur in slate grey, dusty ochre and lichen-green patches with pale speckles, so the round body looks like a boulder covered in moss and dry grass when it freezes.

The limbs are six short, stubby, padded legs, three per side, tucked under the round belly, ending in blunt hoof-like pads and no clawed paws; the tail is absent, replaced by a short tuft of filaments on the rear.

invariants: Round, fog-fat, plump body shape and low squat stance
Long navigation whiskers/filaments kept and made more prominent
Soft dense fur rather than scales or skin
Single creature at drawSize 0.8 scale, centered, readable at small size
Transparent background, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline
Four facings consistent in colour, mottling and proportions: front view eyes toward the viewer, rear view seen from behind, side views in profile

Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background, centered, readable at small size. Body: a plump, round, fog-fat low-slung body like a living boulder, covered in dense stone-like mottled fur in slate grey, dusty ochre and lichen-green patches with pale speckles, so it looks like a mossy rock when it holds still. Head: a smooth, blunt, wedge-shaped head sunk into the round body, with a flat brow plate and no rodent snout; the eyes are tiny vestigial slits sealed under pale lids, almost hidden in the fur. Sensory organs: dozens of long, thin, stiff sensory filaments grow in rows along the brow, the cheeks and both flanks, fanning outward and swept slightly back like a ring of antennae, longer and more numerous than ordinary whiskers; they are the way it navigates by smell and touch. Limbs: six short, stubby, padded legs, three per side, tucked beneath the belly, ending in blunt hoof-like pads; the rear carries a short tuft of filaments in place of a tail. Front view: head toward the viewer, eyes-slits and brow filaments visible. Rear view, seen from behind: the round back, the filament tuft and the haunches, the head hidden. Side views: profile showing the blunt wedge head, the flank filaments and the three legs on the near side. Same palette, mottling and proportions in every view. reference: none
